wwo.name: Istanbul
wwo.method: Stamboul peninsula, water and wall-edge tracks from Thuillier, independently traced Pera and Taksim from Godeffroy, and Üsküdar shore and streets from Malûmat. The map distinguishes purpose-mapped ordinary blocks, working shore, municipal gardens, cemeteries and approaches to the city wall. Exact paving, widths, individual houses, masonry relief, measured historic terrain and navigable ferry simulation remain unresolved.

registration.method: Independent affine registration of each plate using surviving fixed points. North-bank handoff at the historical lower-Pera ascent. Distortions are greatest along the Stamboul wall and least near the sample interiors.
registration.precision_limit: Fit residuals measure the selected visually transferred points, including paper distortion and coordinate reading. They are not independent geodetic accuracy observations; the scale limits parcel and wall-width precision.

from.name: Bosphorus boat landing east of Eminönü

ferry_connections.status: historical relationship and land-access geometry only

sources.title: L. Thuillier, Plan de Constantinople (Stamboul), Hachette, BnF GE D-23085
sources.date: BnF catalogue 1890s; 2 92 printing mark on the plate
sources.precision: 1:30,000. Peninsula, inner port, bridges, valley routes, built blocks, gardens, gates and station ground.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: L. Godeffroy, Plan de Péra, Annuaire Oriental, Cervati Frères, SALT APLGF001
sources.precision: 1:6,000. Mapped street lines, separate buildings, compounds, burial grounds, parks, barracks and houses on the northern high ground.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Plan de Constantinople published by Malûmat, Hakkı Tarık Us collection
sources.date: French title 1895; Ottoman 1312; digitisation catalogue labelled 1896
sources.precision: Üsküdar shore, roads, built groups and open ground. Corroborates the independent peninsula and north-bank sources.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Brockhaus Konversations-Lexikon, Konstantinopel
sources.precision: 1:67,200. Cross-check for named Asian and west wall neighbourhoods. Terrain shading locates historical hillside context; it supplies no numeric elevations.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Spry, plan of the Central Bazars of Constantinople, British Library
sources.precision: Published market diagram corroborates the principal routes and covered-market uses in the peninsula. No exact parcel geometry inferred from the diagram.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: UNESCO Historic Areas of Istanbul
sources.precision: Period identities for the main Sultanahmet and Süleymaniye monuments. Current records were used to confirm location and identity.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Fatih Municipality, Historical Peninsula districts and land walls
sources.date: Surviving historic fabric and historical chronology
sources.precision: Identity of the gates, defensive towers and surviving monuments.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Fatih district governor, Historic bridges
sources.date: Historical Golden Horn crossings listed from the 19th century
sources.precision: Corroborates historical two bridge relationships. The 1890s alignment comes from the Stamboul plate.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Üsküdar Municipality, Explore Üsküdar
sources.precision: Verifies persistent names and relative positions of Şemsi Paşa, Mihrimah, Yeni Valide and Atik Valide.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.

sources.title: Şehir Hatları, Şirket-i Hayriye history
sources.precision: Evidence for period Bosphorus transport. This record does not fix a course through the water or a timetable.
sources.licence: Historical map geometry redrawn for the sample. Archive images and other site media remain in local research storage.
